title: iTransformer channel-conditioned Mirror residual
hypothesis: On held-out future windows of a distinct multi-sensor dataset, two per-sensor Givens coordinates on iTransformer variate tokens improve macro standardized MSE by at least 2% over shared cross-variate attention and beat byte-matched diagonal FiLM, without reducing robustness when input sensors are ablated.
physical_object: One shared iTransformer variate-token embedding, cross-variable attention trunk and forecast head
mirror_coordinate: Per-sensor angle and log-gain applied as a 2D rotation-scale to the first two hidden coordinates of each variate token before cross-variable attention
logical_multiplicity: Sensor-conditioned forecasts while retaining attention across available variate tokens
controls: shared iTransformer trunk with no coordinates
two-value per-sensor diagonal FiLM on first two token coordinates

data.selection: first 16 stored sensor channels; scalar sensor reading only, no semantic units asserted
data.split: chronological 60/20/20; context 96, horizon 24; 48 evenly spaced train origins, 12 development origins, 12 audit origins

model.implementation: iTransformer variate tokenization and cross-variable attention; reduced CPU configuration trained from scratch
model.training: same initialization for shared variants; AdamW lr 0.001, batch 16 windows, 12 epochs fixed, same origins/order

development.selection_metric: macro standardized MSE on development origins; no hyperparameter changes after audit begins

success_gate: Mirror improves audit standardized MSE by >=2% over hard sharing and matched FiLM, passes sensor-input ablation non-inferiority within 2%, and is smaller than independent per-sensor payload.
failure_gate: Mirror fails the 2% quality gate, FiLM matches/beats it, or sensor ablation degrades >2% versus shared baseline.
boundaries: one seed and fixed budget do not establish capacity
CPU-scale iTransformer is not a full official benchmark reproduction
source README supplies scalar sensor readings without semantic units; no units or semantic meaning claimed
one dataset and 16 sensor channels only
data file hash/shape were inspected as a schema-feasibility check before protocol was re-persisted after executor workspace reconnection; no model outputs or audit metrics were accessed
